passRule.note: Each skill is a separate 100-point paper and must independently reach 60/100; the 240-point headline sum cannot compensate for a failed paper. This project-defined assessment uses contemporary standard written Tamil for reading and writing, accepts standard spoken Tamil for listening and speaking, and credits documented regional forms used consistently. The checked external sources publish no CEFR-mapped Tamil B2 administration, timing, preparation, grouping, task-count, or validation measurements, so those values are project choices. This is not an external qualification, and publishing this inventory does not establish mock readiness, calibration, human validation, learner readiness, or learner attainment.
